How I got into Touhou is actually a bit of an amusing story. I was really into Raiden and Ikaruga when I was in high school, I had tried out Touhou once or twice, but there was a huge stigma against anime-ish things in my school, so nothing really came of it. When I started college, I offhandedly mentioned that I had played Touhou once before and was told there was someone I should meet.

I was basically dragged out of the public space, taken to his room, and 'indoctrinated' into Touhou for 3 hours or so using various Touhou videos. I could've left at any time, but I chose not to. Today we are good friends and room mates. I'm honestly not sure if I would have gotten into Touhou if it was not for that offhanded remark.

My favorite game would probably be 14. It looks so crisp at the higher resolution and plays really well.

My favorite character is definitely Eirin. I really like the dynamic between Eirin and Yukari. Eirin also is the sort of character I looked up to as a kid: intelligent, logical, and cautious. At least, that's the impression I got. It is also probably due to IN being the first game I finished.
